_comment: Authoritative destructible arena props (#71), read by the server and clients through ArenaProps. Changing any value is a gameplay change: bump WireCodec.BUILD and ship a matching hosted server release. kinds: which arena obstacles break (by obstacle kind and name prefix) and their HP. A broken prop loses its collider on every peer until the next round.

multipliers._comment: Weapon kind -> prop kind -> damage multiplier (unlisted = 1). Saws and grinders fell timber; guns barely chip granite.

melee._comment: Weapon contact with props, keyed by weapon (Atlas front tools by tool: grinder, ram, spear). The tool reaches a sphere of reach (m, before geometry scale) ahead of the hull. dps: continuous damage while the weapon runs (saw, grinder at full spin); hit: one blow per strike or per cooldown seconds (spinners).

ram._comment: A bot driving into a prop above min_closing_speed (m/s) deals damage_per_speed per m/s over it, scaled by the bot's mass over reference_mass, once per cooldown seconds per prop.
